Let me analyze the error in cell 2.

The error message is:
```
TypeError: only integer scalar arrays can be converted to a scalar index
```

This error occurs on the line:
```python
plt.title(class_names[train_labels[i]])
```

The issue is that `train_labels[i]` is an array with shape `(1,)`, not a scalar integer. In CIFAR-10 dataset, the labels are returned with shape `(50000, 1)` - meaning each label is a 2-element array like `[0]`, `[1]`, etc., not a scalar.

To fix this, I need to extract the scalar value from the array. I can do this by using `.item()` or indexing with `[0]`.

Let me fix cell 2 by changing:
```python
plt.title(class_names[train_labels[i]])
```
to:
```python
plt.title(class_names[train_labels[i][0]])
```

Actually, looking more carefully, `train_labels[i]` returns an array of shape `(1,)`, so `train_labels[i][0]` would give us the scalar value.

Let me make this fix.
